audit.h1: The Candle In The Kitchen, The Spray In The Living Room, The Plug-In In The Bedroom: Here’s What They Actually Leave In The Air Your Kids And Pets Breathe.
audit.lede: The EPA lists burning candles and incense among the sources of fine particles in your home: particles small enough to get deep into the lungs. Now look at who's sitting closest to the candle tonight.
audit.desc: Why fill your home with smoke and chemicals just because they smell good? Read these 5 alerts before you do it again.
